values.name: Sun State — Trailer Sales
values.noticeBody: Talk to a member of our sales team about our available inventory, financing, or to schedule an in-person appointment.

values.heading: When we're open.
values.note: Dedicated trailer repair bays and a parts counter share the Tampa campus, with service hours running 7 AM – 7 PM weekdays and after-hours coverage via Certified Fleet.

values.heading: A good business starts with the right equipment.
values.body: Our purpose at Sun State Trailers is to help you find the right trailers for your business. New Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailers sit alongside a rotating selection of used units, and if the spec you need isn't on the lot we'll order it or alter one to fit.

items.title: New trailers
items.body: Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailers built for Florida freight — dry van, reefer, flatbed and specialty configurations.

items.title: Used trailers
items.body: A rotating selection of inspected used trailers, with service history and repairs documented by our own technicians.

items.title: Financing
items.body: Retail financing, municipal leasing and flexible payment structures with minimum down payment and approved credit.

items.title: Parts & service
items.body: Dedicated trailer repair bays, liftgate work, DOT inspections, and Hyundai and all-makes trailer parts on the same campus.

values.heading: Other Sun State locations.
values.body: Ready to find the right commercial trucks for your business? Visit us at our convenient locations across Central and Southwest Florida.

items.q: Where is Sun State Trailer Sales?
items.a: Trailer Sales is at 6020 Adamo Drive, Tampa, FL 33619, sharing the Tampa dealership campus. Phone (813) 621-1331, fax 813-628-0527.

items.q: What are the Trailer Sales store hours?
items.a: The store is open 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Friday, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

items.q: Which trailer brands do you sell?
items.a: New Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailers, plus a rotating selection of used trailers. We stock dry van, reefer, flatbed and specialty configurations.

Yes. Talk to a member of our sales team about available inventory, financing, or to schedule an in-person appointment. Retail financing, municipal leasing and flexible payment structures are available with approved credit.

items.q: Do you service and stock parts for trailers here?
items.a: Yes. The Tampa campus has dedicated trailer repair bays and a parts counter covering kingpins, landing gear, aluminum and fiberglass repair, liftgates, DOT inspections and Hyundai and all-makes trailer parts.

items.q: Can I customize or alter a trailer?
items.a: Yes. If you need to customize or alter your trailer to fit your specific needs, our fabrication and welding shop handles frame alterations, wheelbase changes, body wraps and liftgate work at our Tampa aftermarket facility.

values.heading: Ready to find the right trailer?
values.body: Contact us to explore our trailers and experience nothing less than the dedicated care you deserve.
